purpose: Additional evidence review; not calculator input and not activation approval.

new_findings.source: FAO GIEWS Country Brief, reference date 2026-06-23
observations: Cassava is the main food crop and is cultivated throughout the year in northern and southern areas, with seasonal timing depending on rainfall.
The 2026 main-season maize harvest was completed in January and estimated near average; secondary-season planting concluded in March for July harvest under generally favourable moisture conditions.

2026 cereal imports forecast at 410,000 tonnes, including 260,000 tonnes wheat and 100,000 tonnes rice; approximately 90% of cereal utilization is imported. These are import/utilization estimates, not domestic production or farm yield.
new_findings.decision: Qualitative outlook only; do not convert it into crop yield or profit inputs.

new_findings.source: Institut National de la Statistique du Congo
observations: The official portal lists monthly consumer-price bulletins through August 2026 (M8-2026).

Its displayed city indicators include February 2026 IHPC index points for Brazzaville, Dolisie, Ouesso, Owando and Pointe-Noire, with national inflation indicator; these are consumer price indices, not item-level commodity prices.
new_findings.decision: Useful source route for price monitoring, but no XAF/kg producer prices can be inferred from index points.

new_findings.topic: Ministry of Commerce market and price monitoring dashboard
new_findings.source: Ministère du Commerce, des Approvisionnements et de la Consommation
observations: The portal describes monitoring of prices, markets, trade and publications, and advertises 42 collection points, 126 essential products and 12 available 2026 bulletins.
The page shows a June 2026 tracked-price index of 108.4 and a 1.8% change; this is an aggregate index, not an individual farmgate quote.
new_findings.decision: Promising official route for item/market tables; downloadable detailed series and price-level classification still need extraction.

observations: Public page describes weekly on-site market collection, 22+ markets and 27+ products, with coverage including Brazzaville, Pointe-Noire, Dolisie, Oyo, Owando, Ouesso, Mossendjo and Nkayi.
Public sample is dated 2026-04-27: cassava Brazzaville XAF 320/kg, tomato Pointe-Noire XAF 850/kg, plantain Dolisie XAF 410/kg.
Full price histories and alerts require an account; the public sample does not establish farmgate level, grade, sample count or producer transaction.
new_findings.decision: Retain only as market-side context until sample export and transaction level are verified.

existing_evidence_rechecked: INS 2024 Enquête sur les productions végétales and RGA-Congo 2024 preliminary results are listed, but their numerical tables were not extracted in this review.
Historical secondary crop totals for 2024 remain cross-check leads only; department-level area, production and yield have not been validated.
No dated farmgate producer-price schedule or farmer-paid input-cost schedule was found in the reviewed public material.
No complete department-level enterprise budgets or calculator regression cases are available.

readiness_decision.geography: department list and effective-date crosswalk still require primary legal confirmation
readiness_decision.currency: XAF confirmed; unit/rounding regression tests not built

decision: Republic of the Congo remains research-only. No calculator profile activation, code change, merge, or deployment is claimed.
next_step: Extract numerical crop/area tables from INS 2024 survey and RGA preliminary report; obtain official item-level price exports from INS/Commerce and verify producer-versus-retail classification; then collect farmer-paid input quotations and department-specific budgets.
